page_title: RMA 2-0 VIL | Real Madrid v Villarreal 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+4' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
90+3' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+3' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) picks up an injury.
90+2' The substitution has been made. Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) has replaced Luka Modric.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
89' A lofted cross from Juan Bernat (Villarreal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
89' Villarreal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sergi Cardona walks off the pitch to be replaced by Juan Bernat (Villarreal).
84' A big opportunity missed by Thierno Barry (Villarreal). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the right post.
81' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
81' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
79' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Vinicius Junior and he is replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
79' The substitution is prepared. Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dani Parejo.
77' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece.

73' 2 - 0 Federico Valverde looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the top right corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 2:0.
71' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) replaces Kylian Mbappe.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eder Militao (Real Madrid) replaces Eduardo Camavinga.
70' The opposition can't get near Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
68' Today's match ends for Alex Baena who will be replaced by Yeremy Pino (Villarreal).
68' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Pepe will be replaced by Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal).
68' A substitution has been made. Raul Albiol is replaced by Eric Bailly (Villarreal).
67' Flag goes up against Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
66' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
63' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
63' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.
59' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
58' The free kick is taken short by Real Madrid.
58' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Real Madrid.
55' Alex Baena (Villarreal) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but the effort goes just wide of the right post.
54' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) commits a rough foul. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and makes a call. Villarreal are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
51' The linesman signals that Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
50' The attendance for today's match is 73842.
49' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
47' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Guillermo Cuadra has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.

38' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the left post.
36' That's an easy save for Diego Conde, following a first time shot towards the middle of the goal from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
36' The free kick is taken by Luka Modric (Real Madrid), but ball is cleared.
36' Alex Baena (Villarreal) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Guillermo Cuadra signals. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Madrid.
34' The free kick picks out Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) in space, but his close-range header flies miles over the bar.
33' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Kiko Femenia (Villarreal).
31' A brilliant individual effort! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
31' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
29' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
28' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The foul by Santi Comesana (Villarreal) was seen by Guillermo Cuadra who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
26' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in a cross from the corner, but Andriy Lunin reads it well and gathers the ball.
24' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
24' Real Madrid try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
23' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid win a free kick.
20' Alex Baena (Villarreal) plays a through ball but overhits it.

16' Crossbar! Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Luka Modric passes the ball to Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Diego Conde couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
14' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) works the corner short.
13' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
11' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) decided to try his luck with a first-time shot. He probably immediately regrets his decision as he skies the ball out.
9' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
9' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
7' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley high over the bar from inside the box.
4' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will take a corner kick.
